content: Mbǝghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ daddkwa ǝmtsamtsan nǝ vǝgha
Kaa daas kǝ Yesu damma pɛrayuwa, ngal dagal tǝghǝra yu damma Kafarnahum, kǝssi ghubara nǝ iina.

Kaa sagau kǝ uudah dǝ daddakwa ǝmtsamtsan nǝ vǝgha hǝngan tǝ kǝjja, nǝghǝgha ba nǝ Yesu kǝ fadghǝratǝra, aiyama kǝ daddakwa ǝmtsaǝmtsan nǝ vǝghǝna “Zǝrara, ndavbiya, ɓǝshakanaɓǝshǝg nǝ uud kǝ haipahagha.”
Cinngara ba nǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha ǝndkwaha, kaa takǝvatag kǝ iitǝr mataatakaatǝr taakiya, “Kwanǝn kǝ uuda badza ɗaaga Daadamazhigǝla!”
Nǝghakanǝghǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ dzamaghǝraatǝra, amaa kǝ iitǝra, “Aujibǝg am dzama kǝlaadǝr ma ǝrvidmahuɗaruwi?
Kwar wa tsaftsaf kǝ taga, taakiya, ‘Bǝshakanaɓǝshǝg nǝ uud kǝ haipahagha nii ciiga dǝgdagalhi?’
Ən naagaan am sǝran taakiya Zǝra Uuda dǝ ndzǝɗa ɓǝsha haipah ma duniya.” Kaa amaa taa kǝ daddakwa ǝmtsamtsan nǝ vǝghna, “Ciig kǝssǝg kǝjjagha dǝg daas dahǝnyaha.”
Tǝhalakwaha, kaa ciig kǝ uudanǝna, ngal daas kǝ iin da vǝgyaana.
Nǝghara ba nǝ dzahava dlamakǝlaawa ǝndkwaha, kaa gǝdzǝg kǝ iitǝra, ar gala Daadamazhigǝla kwa vǝlgar hulfa kwan kǝ ndzǝɗ kǝ uudaha.
Ɗaaghantɗag nǝ Yesu kǝ Matiyu
Ɗughars ba nǝ Yesu kǝ vakavaka kwahiina, kaa nǝghǝganǝhǝg kǝ iina kǝ uuda nǝ iin kwa ɗahav dǝ Matiyu cihurgan vaka cauwa hadama. Am Yesu taa kǝ iina “Gatkwagatǝga” ngal ciig kǝ iin kaa gatǝgaana.
Tǝhalakwaha, kaa za kaf kǝ Yesu ma vǝgya Matiyu, ngal sagau kǝ lii cauwa hadama ard yaa dadda haip ba ɗyaka ar cihuran buud za kaf kǝ iitǝr dǝ iina ard mbǝrzahaana.
Nǝghǝra ba nǝ Farisiyah ǝntkwaha, ngal am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ mbǝrzahaana, “Aujibǝg kǝ dadda hǝnyaharu za kaf ǝmtaɗ dǝ lii cauwa hadama ard yaa dadda haipi?”
Cinngha ba nǝ Yesu ǝntkwaha, aiyama, “Lii yanga maay lambatǝr dǝ dadda mba uud biya, bamma lii yang biya.
Damdǝg tsagamtsag kǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai wanǝna, ‘Zhuwadaal wan naag nai vakaruwa kyulǝgg biya.’ Sanhi da ɗaa lii jiir bi nai biya, sanhi mbakyarvad yaa dadda haipa.”
Ndavǝg tǝghǝr kǝ kǝssa andǝla
Kaa dagau nǝ mbǝrzaha Yuhwana dadda tsuufǝg davak Yesu, am nǝ iitǝra, “Aujilbg kǝskǝmnd ard Farisiyah kǝm kǝsgaan ka andǝla, kwakyarvadau kǝ mbǝrzahah ar maay kǝsgani?”

Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Ar badzǝgaan nǝ tsaghwaha zhiila ghuula kǝ ǝrvidmahuɗ ma bar ǝmtaɗ dǝ zhiila ghuula? Da sagau sarta kwa da kǝsav zhiila ghuula dagal vakatǝra, ar da kǝssǝg ma kwah sarta nǝ iitǝra kǝ andǝla.
“Maay wa ghudgǝtghudǝg kǝ daala sǝɗav tlappant tǝ ǝnghura sǝɗav biya aɗaba da tǝhgaan kǝ ǝnghura sǝɗav na, tǝhgaana, da jǝguujǝg kwa ndza wura.

Maay wa ɗiya daala yuwa inabi damma ǝnghura ambǝla hǝllu biya, akwama ɗiyavdǝmɗiiga, ciɓgaan kǝ ǝnghura ambǝla hǝllwuna, ɗiya dagal nǝ yuwa inabiya badzǝgaan kǝ ambǝla hǝlluwa. Daala yuwa inabi ɗiyav bamma daala ambǝla hǝlluwa tǝvad kwah wa da ɗiigal bi nǝ iin biya dlaɓa ciɓǝgai nǝ ambǝla hǝllu biya.”
Dǝghwa Yayirus ard uus kwa kǝla avǝza
Ma sarta taa kwanǝn kǝ Yesu, kaa sagau nǝ maala ma guda dzǝgwazhigǝla da vakaana, kǝla kǝ ghuunj tǝvuukwana, amaa, “Dǝghwar aa ǝmtsǝga ba ndakwana, asǝg tapnatapǝg da ciiga.”
Kaa dagal kǝ Yesu ard mbǝrzahaan gata uuda nǝ iina.
Mǝng nǝ uusiin viigaan kǝlawa tar buwa kǝla avǝza, ka dagau kǝ iina gyilga Yesu tapǝna kǝ ghaiya sǝɗavaana.
Amaa ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, “Akwama tapannatapǝg aanji ba ghaiya sǝɗavaan kaltiya, ǝn da mbǝga.”
Gwiyavǝt ba nǝ Yesu kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝga, aiyama, “Ndav bi dǝghwar biya, fadghǝragha mɓakanambǝga.” Batwatsǝra, kaa mbǝga kǝ uusina.
Dagha ba nǝ Yesu da vǝgya maala ma guda dzǝgwazhigǝlǝna, kaa nǝhganǝhǝg kǝ iin kǝ lii fǝrta faakila ard dzahava dlamaa kǝlaaw ar tuuga.
Aiyam nǝ Yesu, “Ciyamciig vaakwana, ǝmtsabi nǝ dughwiin biya, hǝnnahaara.” Kaa ɓagar ghuɓasǝga nenneg kǝ iitǝra.
Lagwavtǝrda ba nǝ uudah da gyǝmala, kaa daas kǝ iina hǝkyinan kǝ dǝva dughwiina, ngal ciiga.
Kaa cinngalcinng nǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ iin aanji taakwara.
Mbǝghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ gulfaha ard matangaha
Ɗughars ba nǝ Yesu kǝ vakavak kǝ iina, kaa ba gatǝgaan kǝ gulfah buwa ar ɗaag bad halavuwa ndzǝɗaatǝr ar taakiya, “Zhukǝmndaalazhug, Zǝra Dauda!”
Dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma kwatlǝrǝn kǝ hǝnyaha, kaa daas kǝ gulfah bu da vakaana, aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Famdǝghǝrtfǝg taakiya ǝn mbǝkurambǝga?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Aana, Yaazhigǝla.”
Tǝhala kwaha, kaa tapǝna kǝ iin kǝ gyiyahaatǝra aiyama, “Tǝdvad fadhǝraruwa, mbǝkurmbǝg nǝ uuda?”
Ngal wurǝg kǝ gyiyahaatǝra, tǝhala kwaha ka ɓǝltǝra nǝ Yesu kǝ magi ba vaivaiya amaa, “Tagamarbi aanji kǝ war biya.”
Daral ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa ba kutǝgaan kǝ iitǝr kǝ ǝlbǝgǝn tǝghǝr kǝ iin aanji takwar ma lardiina.
Ar tǝ ɗuula sagala, kaa sǝvardǝvsǝg nǝ daddakwa mamghant nǝ shatanaha kǝ Yesu.
Savda ba nǝ Satanahna, kaa fǝgarzhafǝg kǝ uuda nǝ iin kǝ taa ghaiya, kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ dzahava dlama kǝlaawa, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Ba dǝm tapavnai kǝ nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ hulfa kwan kǝ dǝgit ma Izrail biya.”
Aiyam Farisiyaha, “Abi lagw dǝ ndzǝɗa maala Shatanah nǝ iin kǝ shatanaha.”
Zhuwatǝrdaalazhuug nǝ Yesu kǝ uudaha

Tǝhala kwaha, kaa gwaivagwaig kǝ Yesu ma kǝssaha ard gǝdzǝr kǝssaha, tsagtǝrtsag ma guda dzugwazhigǝla, tagtǝr ǝlbǝg maraw tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝkǝsǝra Daadamazhigǝla, mbahtǝran dlaɓ kǝ uudahi dǝ kuzah shahshaha ard lii yang biya.
Nǝgha ba nǝ iin kǝ dzahava dlamaa kǝlaaw baɗyaka, kaa zhutǝrdalaazhuuga. Aɗaba ar hǝɓa dlaɗa maay wa mǝltǝrumǝlǝg biya, ar band tughwahǝn kwal dadda piiga.
Aiyama taa kǝ mbǝrzahaana, “Tlǝra ghuda hǝi ba ɗyaka, dlaɓa lii ɓa tlǝra ar ba ǝnkykwahha.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, ghalamghalǝg kǝ dadda guhha maa dzǝgaraa kǝ lii ɓaa tlǝra, maraa ghudara kǝ hǝiya.”
